messages:
Jamie: heads-up — canary promotion is blocked for the 12:00 UTC window. CI shows package-sign job succeeded but the canary runner fails during artifact extract (docker layer unpack). deploy-bot flagged the promo as blocked. Anyone seeing more detail?
Sara: seeing the same. only failing on eu-west linux runners so far. logs show EOF during tar extract.
DeployBot: Automated Alert — canary-promo #3827 failed
  job: package-extract
  runner: eu-west-3-runner-12
  exit: 1
  last-logs: "tar: unexpected EOF"
Mike: :( is this a flaky storage read or a corrupt artifact? checksum on registry matches what the builder produced?
Sara: checksum on registry (sha256:5f3a...) matches builder output. builder upload reported success. suspecting transient s3/gcs chunking or runner cache corruption. infra-bot, any anomalies on object-store?
infra-bot: Observability — object-store WRITE lat spikes between 1712443000-1712443200. 503 retries observed from 10 distinct upload shards.
Priya: we've seen similar with multipart shards failing mid-upload — clients mark as success if the final complete call completes but some runners still stream from a bad shard. quick fix: reupload artifact with single-part (small) or force re-run of package job.
Jamie: options: 1) pin promo to last good artifact (promote-old) 2) re-run package job and reupload (may miss change window) 3) manual reupload artifact from builder node (fastest). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Mike: I'm +1 for pin-old if it's safe. Anyone run the acceptance smoke against the previous artifact?
Sara: ran smoke yesterday on the previous artifact — green. If we pin, we should note in release notes and follow-up with a rebuild for the new hash.
Jamie: Agree. Action: hold promotion, pin to artifact sha256:3b2d... (last good), deploy-bot please prepare manual-promote PR and lock change window. Priya will re-run a clean package-build after we confirm infra stabilizes. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Acknowledged — created promote request #PR-614 on release channel, marking promo blocked -> manual-promote pending approval.
Mike: I'll approve the manual promote when PR is up. Also creating a postmortem ticket for multipart upload retry logic.
Sara: adding a brief note to release_notes.md: "Canary promotion held; using previous artifact due to transient artifact-extract failure; rebuild scheduled."
Jamie: thanks team. keeping window locked for 30 more mins while Priya runs the rebuild. If infra-bot reports no more 5xxs after that, we'll retry full promo path.
Priya: starting re-run now, ETA ~9 mins. will paste logs if anything else pops.
infra-bot: Observability update — 5xx spike subsided at 1712443440, no new write errors in last 2 mins.
Jamie: great, stand by for follow-ups. :eyes:
